title: Order Desk Notification
description: The content of the plain-text Order Desk Notification to the Order Desk mailbox for a Rejected Peakmart Order (UC-002 A4, BR-004). Trailhead Gear owns it. It allows no other field, so that no Customer name, email address or Shipping Address can get into it (C-023). The subject is `Peakmart order <Order Number> rejected`, in English (FR-031); how the text is laid out is not part of the model.

orderNumber.description: Order Number of the Rejected Peakmart Order.

rejectionReasons.description: Every Rejection Reason, in the order of the Order Checks (UC-003 A3).
